claim: To encrypt data in transit with CloudFront you configure it to require that viewers use HTTPS, and you can also configure it to use HTTPS to get files from your origin.
question: How do you encrypt both legs of a CloudFront connection in transit?

values.display: require that viewers use HTTPS to request your files
use HTTPS to get files from your origin

evidence.quote: To encrypt your data during transit, you configure Amazon CloudFront to require that viewers use HTTPS to request your files, so that connections are encrypted when CloudFront communicates with viewers. You also can configure CloudFront to use HTTPS to get files from your origin, so that connections are encrypted when CloudFront communicates with your origin.
